concerns.text: Phase 6 ('Revision - Synaptic Reserve & Plasticity Features') introduces tasks T044, T045, and T046 to fetch plasticity markers and retrain models. These tasks have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or User Story (US) in spec.md or plan.md. The spec/plan define the scope as topology-based prediction; adding 'synaptic reserve' features is an unapproved scope expansion with no traceable requirement.

Task T029b enforces n=500 permutations and mandates aborting if runtime exceeds limits. This contradicts FR-005 (spec.md) which states the test is 'bounded by max_runtime=2 hours' (implying n can be reduced) and Plan.md which explicitly reduces the target to n=100. There is no task covering the 'reduced n' fallback path required by the spec/plan to satisfy the runtime constraint.

Task T030 (Sensitivity Analysis) requires re-training the model for every threshold variation (2, 3, 4 points). While FR-012 requires sensitivity on the 'decline threshold definition', the spec/plan do not explicitly mandate re-training for every variation in the implementation tasks. More critically, the task conflates 'decision threshold sweep' (FR-006, usually on fixed model) with 'label definition sensitivity' (FR-012). The current task description is ambiguous on whether it covers both FR-006 and FR-012 correctly, and the 're-train' requirement for FR-006 (decision threshold) is not supported by the spec.

Task T017 filters for eligible subjects but the description does not explicitly mention generating the 'log of excluded subjects' required by FR-001 and Plan.md Phase 1 Step 1.1. While T017 mentions 'data/processed/excluded_subjects.log' in the output list, the task description text ('filter for subjects... limit to N... fail if zero') lacks the explicit instruction to log exclusions, creating a traceability gap for the exclusion logic required by the spec.

Task T019 defines CSV schema including 'local_efficiency'. Spec.md FR-002 and Plan.md Phase 1 Step 1.2 only explicitly list 'node degree, global efficiency, clustering coefficient, path length'. The inclusion of 'local_efficiency' is an unverified feature not covered by a specific FR/SC, though it is a common metric. This is a minor scope drift.
